messages.text: Hi there! Long story, sorry. My sister visited last week and we redecorated the living room, and the rattan lampshade just didn't go with the new colours at all, so I sent it back on Monday. The brass base stays, I love it. Oh, and do you know if the green velvet cushions will be back in stock soon? Anyway, can I get my money back for the shade?
